title: Scope and owners
evidence: Choose real course/syllabus, data classification, operator and backup; fund support and durable storage for the whole term.
stop: No named owner or approved service period.

title: Provider and access
evidence: Confirm approved route, course eligibility, actual roster/login, quotas, images, costs, GPU status and data/expiry terms.

title: Component canary
owner: One instructor + up to ten consenting volunteers
evidence: Run one representative DS assignment and one public-records MLIS workflow; use a fixed image and retain launch, save/restart/export evidence.
stop: Core software or save/export path fails.

title: Capacity rehearsal
evidence: Test approved peak concurrency with provider permission; measure queue/spawn latency, CPU/RAM, storage and actual billed idle time. Suggested p95 login-to-workspace target: five minutes, to negotiate with provider.
stop: Unmeasured or insufficient class capacity; credit/storage forecast exceeds award.

title: Recovery and teach-out
owner: Primary and backup operators + Libraries liaison
evidence: Restore files and service onto a second host; verify cross-student isolation, learner export and grade reconciliation. Proposed RPO 24 hours/RTO one business day require measurement.
stop: No independent restorable backup or viable offline/CPU fallback.

title: Two-course pilot
evidence: 80 illustrative seats; required work CPU-capable. GPU/OSPool/MESA modules only after their own gate passes; collect support time, billing and instructional outcomes.
stop: Unsafe access, recurring capacity failure or no funded support.

title: Retire or renew
when: Decision at least 30 days before expiry (proposed)
evidence: Export students/grades, reconcile submissions, deposit approved public outputs with Libraries; confirm next-term project/renewal route and verify deletion.
stop: Assuming automatic education extension or treating grace periods as service funding.
